mintAuthority.summary: EUROP Ethereum has 3 active MINTER_ROLE holders: EOA (also DEFAULT_ADMIN), a 3/3 Safe, and an OFT bridge owned by a 2/4 Safe. Owner Safe (3/4) confirmed on ETH, Avax, and Polygon. XRPL issuer has master key disabled. Plasma chain (rpc.plasma.to): DEFAULT_ADMIN = 4/3 Safe, plus EOA minter and 3/3 Safe minter and OFT bridge minter all confirmed at block 24254601.

controls.label: EUROP token owner Safe (ETH, Avax, Polygon)
controls.evidence: EUROP owner() on Ethereum confirmed this Safe at block 25295047. owner() on Avalanche (0x8835a2f66a7aaccb297cb985831a616b75e2e16c) returned same address. Polygon owner (0x888883b5f5d21fb10dfeb70e8f9722b9fb0e5e51) returned 0x29e6fb2dd01455472da3dd962c16a37de096b8da (SafeL2) with same 4 owners and threshold 3 via getOwners()/getThreshold() RPC. Avax Safe confirmed via api.safe.global: threshold 3, 4 owners [0x1bCd423f, 0xf362066e, 0x7dFE41D6, 0x7d8806a9], no modules, v1.4.1+L2.

controls.label: EUROP ETH/Polygon EOA DEFAULT_ADMIN + MINTER_ROLE
controls.evidence: At block 25295047: hasRole(MINTER_ROLE, 0xe3997860) = true; eth_getCode = no bytecode (EOA). Also holds DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE on ETH. Same address holds DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE and MINTER_ROLE on Polygon per RoleGranted logs. No RoleRevoked events on ETH.

controls.label: EUROP ETH direct minter Safe (3/3)
controls.evidence: Confirmed GnosisSafeProxy via Blockscout. At block 25295047: hasRole(MINTER_ROLE) = true. getOwners() returned 3 owners [0x70d16d28, 0xc963533b, 0xc5285950]; getThreshold() = 3; getModulesPaginated returned empty array (no modules); guard slot = zero.

controls.label: EUROP ETH OFT bridge MINTER_ROLE (EUROPOFT)
controls.evidence: Identified as EUROPOFT (LayerZero OFT bridge) by Blockscout. At block 25295047: hasRole(MINTER_ROLE) = true. owner() returned 0x04b4cb9d5a8417729231221a8ef22a1d06adb32b (GnosisSafeProxy, 2/4 Safe with owners [0x5379b2b5, 0x1cf1804b, 0xd0ed9bd2, 0x3f433019]).

controls.label: EUROP Plasma DEFAULT_ADMIN (4/3 Safe)
controls.evidence: At Plasma block 24254601: getRoleMember(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, 0) returned 0xd8b39a57...; eth_getCode = GnosisProxy bytecode; getOwners() returned 4 signers; getThreshold() = 3; getModulesPaginated() returned empty (no modules). Same 4-signer set as EUROP Ethereum/Avax owner Safe signers.

controls.label: EUROP Plasma EOA minter
controls.evidence: At Plasma block 24254601: getRoleMember(MINTER_ROLE, 0) returned 0xe3997860...; eth_getCode on Plasma = 0x (EOA). Same EOA confirmed as MINTER_ROLE holder on Ethereum.

controls.label: EUROP Plasma Safe minter (3/3)
controls.evidence: At Plasma block 24254601: getRoleMember(MINTER_ROLE, 1) returned 0xa0b56dbb...; eth_getCode = GnosisProxy bytecode; getOwners() = 3 signers; getThreshold() = 3; getModulesPaginated() empty.

controls.label: EUROP Plasma OFT bridge minter
controls.evidence: At Plasma block 24254601: getRoleMember(MINTER_ROLE, 2) returned 0xf825e476...; eth_getCode = large OFT-style contract bytecode (LayerZero); owner() returned 0x53ef7b6a497e893f739f03969306beb464328101.

review.evidence: ETH: 3 active MINTER_ROLE holders confirmed (EOA, 3/3 Safe, OFT bridge owned by 2/4 Safe). Owner Safe (3/4) confirmed on ETH, Avax, and Polygon. XRPL issuer rMkEuRii9w9uBMQDnWV5AA43gvYZR9JxVK: lsfDisableMaster flag set (master key disabled). Plasma (block 24254601): DEFAULT_ADMIN = 4/3 Safe (0xd8b39a57), MINTER_ROLE[0] = EOA 0xe3997860, MINTER_ROLE[1] = 3/3 Safe (0xa0b56dbb), MINTER_ROLE[2] = OFT contract (0xf825e476, owned by 0x53ef7b6a). All mint-capable surfaces now confirmed.
